name: wo-probe
cmd: GDP_ENGINE_DUMP=/tmp/wo.json GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only consensus_wo_decide --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; grep -E 'join (enumerated|exists)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-300; ls -la /tmp/wo.json; timeout -s KILL 500 bun research/protocols/engine/woprobe.ts /tmp/wo.json 2>&1 | cut -c1-600
